items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: I used to like to hear ... Celestan

ctx.x: Are there any other favorite musicians you had? Who was the best trumpet players in the old days that you liked to hear or play with?
I used to like to hear Renee, I used to like to hear Celestan, Randy Perez during his time when he was living. And Euless Jean was good and Chris Kelly and Sam Morgan and Albert Snighy.
